description: Bullrun's company relationship graph for one stock: named competitors, suppliers, customers and partners, each with its Bullrun ticker when the counterparty is listed, verification status (VERIFIED against a primary filing/source vs search-SUGGESTED), confidence, sole-source flag, quantified dependence where disclosed (e.g. "Cirrus Logic gets 91% of revenue from Apple") and the evidence behind it. Use for supply-chain and second-order risk questions ("who supplies X", "who depends on X", "who competes with X", "which listed companies are exposed if X stumbles"), then call get_company_risk or get_stock_metrics on the counterparties' tickers. Returns only the cached graph and never starts a paid discovery run; a company with no graph yet reports status "none". A missing edge is not proof of no relationship. Read-only.

evidence.description: none = omit evidence sources, keeping counterparties, measurements and evidence counts; sources = source title/URL/type per edge; excerpts = also quoted evidence text.

limitPerRole.description: Max counterparties per role, verified and highest-confidence first.

roles.description: Which relationships to return, from this company's point of view. Default: all four.

ticker.description: Bullrun ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "SAP", "ASML". Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.

verifiedOnly.description: true = only edges confirmed against a primary source (filing, company release). false also returns search-suggested edges, each labelled with its status and confidence.

name: get_company_relationships
title: Get company relationship network
